note: label a clip with: python3 eval/annotate_real_clip.py --clip <dir> --sidecar <this file> -- which replays applied_log (what the renderer was SHOWN). Without that log the annotator can only model pose_at(frame.stamp_sim_s - t0_sim_s), which is what the driver ASKED for and lands ~0.4-0.8 s ahead of the render. The same applied_log is this flight's bird GROUND TRUTH: scripts/check_live_flight_log.py --truth <applied_log> measures closest approach against it rather than against the drone's own detections.
